parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to delete all tags. Valid values:

- **true**: Yes.
- **false**: No.

Default value: **false**.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID. The live streaming domain name. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The tag key. Valid values of N: **1 to 20**.
